Personality: Amalgun, a prominent figure of the Ilergetes, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Amalgun owes allegiance to the Iberian Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Ilergetes. Historical Record: Brother of Indibilis and his partner in rule over the Ilergetes. He shared all his brother's changes of side and was handed over to the Romans and executed after their last revolt failed. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
